result:
`./compile.sh` reports success and produced `out/com/google/gson/internal/bind/util/ISO8601UtilsAgentTest.class`.

Summary: created `tests/com/google/gson/internal/bind/util/ISO8601UtilsAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 3.8 test class (`extends junit.framework.TestCase`) covering:
- the public no-arg constructor
- `format(Date)`, `format(Date,boolean)`, `format(Date,boolean,TimeZone)` — zero-padding, millis inclusion/omission, UTC/GMT `Z` literal, positive/negative/half-hour offsets, null-argument NPE
- `parse(String,ParsePosition)` — full/compact/date-only forms, millis fraction, colon and no-colon offsets, initial-position honoring, position advancement and stopping at trailing garbage, and error cases (missing timezone, invalid text, empty string) expecting `ParseException`
- format→parse round-trip consistency

All expectations were derived directly from the documented format/parse grammar in `api/.../ISO8601Utils.html`, using explicit UTC-based `Calendar` construction so tests don't depend on the system default timezone.
